column3: NKJV has “the Spirit,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the Spirit of Jesus.”
NKJV has “the Lord had called us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “God had called us.”
NKJV has “out of the city,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “outside the gate.”
Close to the Greek; “a spirit of Python” is rendered “a spirit of divination.”
NKJV has “proclaim to us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “to you.”
